prohibited_states.requirement_quote: Cached state/aux/timestamps MUST change to Available only on backend acknowledgment.
Cleanup MUST NOT synthesize backend `ContactEnded`, successful wrap-up or `task:end`.
A late old-generation HTTP/WebSocket/media completion MUST NOT answer a call, install state or settle a replacement operation.
The client does not trigger platform failover or provision entitlement.
